title: Djokovic Battles Back to Beat Zverev at the China Open
summary:
Novak Djokovic came back from a set down to beat top seed Alexander Zverev. He reached the semi-finals of the China Open. Djokovic, a 39-year-old from Serbia, won 4-6 6-4 6-4. Zverev is ranked number two in the world.

It was the first time they had played in just under 16 months. Zverev, who is 29, won the first set. Then Djokovic fought back. He broke Zverev's serve at 5-4 in the second set to level the match. In the third set, he broke Zverev again at 5-4 to win. The loss hurt Zverev's hopes of finishing the year as the world's number one player.

"These are the kind of moments that I still play for, compete for," Djokovic said. The win extended his unbeaten run in Beijing to 32 matches. He is one step closer to a seventh China Open title and his first trophy of 2026. He has won 24 Grand Slam titles, but this year has been hard. "It's been a struggle this year for different reasons," he said.

Next, he plays Daniil Medvedev on Monday.
why_it_matters: Tennis fans can see how an experienced champion can fight back from behind against one of the best players in the world.
